name: national_card_smart
title_en: Iranian smart national card — front side
notes: The modern «کارت هوشمند ملی»: the ID photo sits on the LEFT and the six field rows on the RIGHT.
Rows, top to bottom: شماره ملی، نام، نام خانوادگی، تاریخ تولد، نام پدر، پایان اعتبار.
There is no serial number or gender on this side, so those fields stay empty for this template.
All boxes are normalised 0..1 (x, y, x1, y1) on the perspective-corrected canvas and are tightened onto the real ink by the pipeline.
Calibrated from a rectified photo of a real card (see `scripts/calibrate_template.py`).
